title: Remove Distractions in Photoshop - Day 11
summary: PHLEARN’s Day 11 of the 30 Days of Photoshop teaches two primary strategies for removing distractions from images: a rapid, AI-assisted approach using the Remove tool’s Find Distractions option to eliminate wires and other background clutter with a single click, and a painterly approach that combines the Selection Brush Tool with Generative Fill to remove objects by painting over them and letting AI generate clean replacements. The instructor duplicates the background layer for non-destructive editing, demonstrates one-click removal including background elements and people, and then shows how to paint distractions and apply Generative Fill to produce multiple variations (including hair generation where needed). The video also notes manual alternatives such as the Clone Stamp Tool and Spot Healing Brush for those who prefer non-AI workflows. Overall, the lesson emphasizes quick, scalable distraction removal, with a nod to preserving shadows and continuity, and situates these techniques within the broader 30 Days of Photoshop series.
